name: @starsobservereric/dsh-multi-key-orchestrator
description: Spread one conversation's requests across several API keys of the same provider, cap concurrency per provider / model / key with a slot reserved for the main process, recover from HTTP 429 by rotating keys, and show each key's remaining balance.

meta.title: Multi-Key Orchestrator
meta.description: Give one provider several API keys. Requests are spread across them by a lease, per-provider / per-model / per-key caps keep the total under control while one slot stays free for the main process, a 429 parks only the offending key and rotates to a healthy one, and every key carries a live balance card read from the provider's own quota endpoint.
